exoticPerks.name: Uncanny Arrows
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.
exoticPerks.description: Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.

descriptions.flavorText: See the danger, even when it cannot see you.

exoticPerks.name: Beyond The Veil
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Guardians you make invisible gain damage resistance.
exoticPerks.description: You gain a second Smoke Bomb charge and have damage resistance while invisible. When you make an ally invisible, they gain damage resistance while invisible and you gain melee energy.

descriptions.flavorText: "Stay back. I won't tell you again." —Bjorna-3

exoticPerks.name: Ursine Guard
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improves Sentinel Shield and Unbreakable.
exoticPerks.description: Move faster while guarding with Sentinel Shield or the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Sentinel Shield is converted to Super energy, and damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.

descriptions.flavorText: No ammo? No problem.

exoticPerks.name: Force Multiplier
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Shotgun and melee final blows start health regeneration and extend defensive buffs.
exoticPerks.description: Shotgun and melee final blows start your health regeneration. While you have a defensive buff (Void Overshield, Amplified, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail), your Shotguns and melees deal additional damage and final blows with either extend the duration of those buffs. Provides a moderate benefit to Shotgun airborne effectiveness and reload speed.

descriptions.flavorText: Do not grieve the dying star. Its death kindles newer life, and thus the wheel turns again.

exoticPerks.name: Battle-Hearth
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Gain Super energy for kills and assists inside Well of Radiance.
exoticPerks.description: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.

descriptions.flavorText: The manifestation of pseudophotons and impossible math.

exoticPerks.name: Blessing of Order
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Rifts create beneficial seeker projectiles.
exoticPerks.description: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.

descriptions.flavorText: Never, ever, look back.

While you have a defensive buff (Void Overshield, Amplified, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail), your Shotguns and melees deal additional damage and final blows with either extend the duration of those buffs. Provides a moderate benefit to Shotgun airborne effectiveness and reload speed.

descriptions.flavorText: Do not grieve the dying star. Its death kindles newer life, and thus the wheel turns again.

exoticPerks.name: Battle-Hearth
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Gain Super energy for kills and assists inside Well of Radiance.
exoticPerks.description: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.

descriptions.flavorText: The manifestation of pseudophotons and impossible math.

exoticPerks.name: Blessing of Order
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Rifts create beneficial seeker projectiles.
exoticPerks.description: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.

descriptions.flavorText: Never, ever, look back.

exoticPerks.name: Uncanny Arrows
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.
exoticPerks.description: Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.

descriptions.flavorText: See the danger, even when it cannot see you.

exoticPerks.name: Beyond The Veil
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Guardians you make invisible gain damage resistance.
exoticPerks.description: You gain a second Smoke Bomb charge and have damage resistance while invisible. When you make an ally invisible, they gain damage resistance while invisible and you gain melee energy.

descriptions.flavorText: "Stay back. I won't tell you again." —Bjorna-3

exoticPerks.name: Ursine Guard
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improves Sentinel Shield and Unbreakable.
exoticPerks.description: Move faster while guarding with Sentinel Shield or the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Sentinel Shield is converted to Super energy, and damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.

descriptions.flavorText: No ammo? No problem.
